summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K announcing an application to the London Stock Exchange to admit 228,003,843 new ordinary shares of £0.07 each, to be issued as consideration for its acquisition of ARC Resources Ltd. The admission date is expected to be 3 September 2026. No per-share price or aggregate value was stated, and no premium or advisor was named. The new shares rank equally with existing ordinary shares. Regulatory or shareholder approvals and the acquisition’s expected closing were not disclosed. Watch for further filings detailing the transaction’s financial terms, closing conditions, and any regulatory review.
